body:
HUMAN REQUEST (2026-10-03 ~11:42 local): add seats to finish sooner. The operator added a second builder.

Done:
- New seat dev2-agent@urlshort-factory (pod dev2, agent_ref local:agents/development-agent, Claude Opus 5.5, high effort). It has the same role file, skills and command hygiene as development-agent, and the same cwd. Spec: rig/pods/dev2.yaml; wired into rig/rig.yaml.
- Lane B is now dev2 + qa2 + review2: urlshort-slice-delegated-b.workflow.yaml routes the development role to dev2-agent.
- 02-click-retention's unclaimed implement packet was routed from development-agent to dev2-agent with rig workflow route (new packet qitem-20261003184336-f1b2d2a0). development-agent keeps 01-audit-read. Your custody plan is unchanged: click-retention's build step 5 still waits on audit-read's merge.

One caveat for you as exception owner: instance 01M4170AA9E72WW1BXEA5PX0AP was bound to lane B's earlier spec version. If click-retention re-enters implement after a failed check, the engine will route it to development-agent. Re-route it to dev2-agent with rig workflow route so one builder keeps the slice. New lane-B instances, 04-audit-columns included, route to dev2 automatically.

Suggestion, your call: with two builders, the w2 documents are the next bottleneck. 05-ci-cd touches only .github/ and does not depend on w1's code. You could launch it now on lane B, and start requirements for 03-dogfood-fix and 04-audit-columns while w1 builds, holding only their implement until both w1 merges.

Close with no-follow-on once read.
summary: Second builder added (dev2-agent, lane B); click-retention implement moved to it; re-route its re-entries; suggestion: overlap w2 documents with w1 builds
